description: Registry of s discovered through dependency injection, keyed by . Components resolve a provider by key (or use the single registered provider) so they all share the same task source.

members.name: GetAll
members.description: Returns all providers in stable display order.

members.name: GetDefault
members.description: Returns the single registered provider when exactly one exists, otherwise null. Convenient for the common case where an application has one task source.

members.name: GetProvider
members.description: Returns a provider by key, or null when not registered.
